title: US Physicists Confirm Gravity Prevents Time Travel to the Past
excerpt: American physicists confirmed Hawking's hypothesis that gravity forbids time travel, limiting closed time-like curves despite paradoxes and model instability.
content:
Gravity Blocks Time Travel to the Past, Confirming Stephen Hawking’s Theory, Say American Physicists

Techno yesterday, 22:44 138 viewed

Фізики з США підтвердили, що притягання гравітації може впливати на можливість подорожі в часі, що підтримує теорії Стівена Гокінга. Photo: НВ — Техно

Can Gravity Save Grandfather from the Time Travel Paradox?

According to НВ — Техно: A group of American physicists have developed a model supporting the idea that gravity prevents travel into the past, lending strong evidence to Stephen Hawking’s chronology protection conjecture. Although intriguing, their model remains unstable in its current form. Einstein’s general theory of relativity allows for the theoretical existence of closed time loops, but this possibility raises significant scientific doubts and questions about whether traveling back in time is feasible.

The Complex Paradoxes of Time Travel

Scientific discussions often highlight various paradoxes illustrating the challenges posed by time travel. One of the most famous is the grandfather paradox, frequently referenced in science fiction. For example, the movie 'Back to the Future' explores how altering past events can lead to unpredictable outcomes. Similarly, Ray Bradbury’s story 'A Sound of Thunder' shows how a small change in the past can drastically affect future events, such as the results of a presidential election.

Robert Heinlein’s work 'All You Zombies-' further complicates the concept by featuring a protagonist who is simultaneously their own mother and father, emphasizing the intricate nature of time travel scenarios.

These ongoing debates about the role of gravity in preventing backward time travel continue to captivate both scientists and science fiction enthusiasts, raising profound questions about the fundamental nature of time and space.

Exploring the possibility and implications of traveling to the past is crucial not only for theoretical physics but also for philosophical inquiries into the nature of time. Studying time travel paradoxes helps deepen our understanding of reality’s workings and the physical constraints shaping our experience of time. As scientific knowledge progresses, this fascinating field promises to reveal even more insights into the fabric of the universe.

While the recent findings support the notion that gravity may hinder time travel, it's essential to consider alternative perspectives in this ongoing debate. For instance, the impossibility of time travel has been established by physicist Hongsheng Zhang, who outlines significant exceptions that could challenge our understanding of temporal mechanics.
